brightport_deebo.m: You came for naught. The apples were picked up recently. Should be on their way, if not already delivered.
r: Well, they were supposed to arrive, but didn't.

brightport_deebo0.m: I don't sell my harvest to just anyone, but because I have a contract with the bakery I can give you a batch.

brightport_deebo1.m: Oh no! I just hope nothing happened to my precious apples.
r: Can I get a new batch of apples?
Ok, here you go. [Give him the gold.]
Whaat, I don't have that gold!

brightport_deebo3.m: My workers will have them picked in no time. Go speak with my farmhand, Alduan. He'll give them to you.

brightport_deebo4.m: Then no apples for you, because I don't lend!

brightport_deebo5.m: I already told you they'll be picked soon, just go speak with Alduan in the orchard.

deebo_orchard_deebo_0.m: What a lovely day for some good quality hard work outside.
r: It sounds like you love being outside.
Can I get a new batch of apples for the bakery?
Hello. Eatloni from Brightport sent me to ask about the apples.
I will let you get back to your business. Have a great time enjoying the nice weather.
Can I see what you have to trade?

deebo_orchard_deebo_10.m: I do indeed. But I'll tell you what I really don't enjoy: fixing the property damage done to my farm and losing livestock because of some wild predator!
r: A "predator"? What kind of a predator?
I have killed the Golden jackal and I have the requested proof.
I have killed the Golden jackal, but I can not prove it.

deebo_orchard_deebo_100.m: As far your reward is concerned, I am now willing to sell and trade with you. Please take a look.

deebo_orchard_deebo_20.m: Have you seen that Golden jackal around here?
r: No, sir, I have not. Well, at least I don't think I have.
I want to hunt down and kill that Golden jackal for you.

deebo_orchard_deebo_30.m: Well, it is a four-legged nightmare of a canine that has destroyed my property and killed my pig. I fear that one of my horses will be next.
r: That's terrible news. What are you going to do about it. Besides complaining, that is?

deebo_orchard_deebo_40.m: Funny kid you are. I am looking for someone to hunt it down and kill it.
r: Really! I am more than willing and able to do this job for you.

deebo_orchard_deebo_50.m: That's great to hear! When can you start?
r: Not right now. Can I pick some apples first?

deebo_orchard_deebo_60.m: First, I have to warn you, this is no ordinary forest animal. This thing is capable of dragging away full-sized adult pigs. Be warned now.
r: I am ready! No more talking.
I am not so sure I am capable, but I will give it a try.
I need time to think about the risks.

deebo_orchard_deebo_70.m: OK, I have faith in you.

deebo_orchard_deebo_80.m: The Golden jackal was last seen heading back into the "Sullengard forest" just to the west of my orchard. Return to me with proof of it's death.

deebo_orchard_deebo_81.m: The Golden jackal was last seen heading back into the "Sullengard forest" just to the west of my orchard. Return to me with proof of its death.

deebo_orchard_deebo_85.m: Return to me once you have the proof that it is dead.

deebo_orchard_deebo_90.m:
Wonderful. Let me have it. [You hand over the Golden jackal's fur]
Ah yes, this is indeed proof it is dead.

r: Well, it is one of the biggest buildings that I've ever seen. What's in there?

deebo_orchard_deebo_barn_talk_20.m: Supplies for my orchard and for my horses.
r: Can I see for myself? I would like to climb up into the loft for some much needed fun.

deebo_orchard_deebo_barn_talk_30.m: No way! You are annoying me. Go away kid.
r: OK. I will leave you be.

deebo_orchard_deebo_horse_talk_10.m: Oh, thank you so much. I am so proud of them.
r: You should be. Can I ride one?

deebo_orchard_deebo_horse_talk_20.m: WHAT?! No way that's going to happen.
r: Fine. But can we talk about your barn instead?

deebo_orchard_deebo_horse_talk_30.m: No way. Is there anything else that you want to talk about?
r: Well, I was also wondering about your barn.

brightport_bakery.10: He told me to start by sweeping the floor, and to do that I must find a broom.
brightport_bakery.15: The floor's all swept. I did it all by myself. Delon's "help" was more of a nuisance.

brightport_bakery.50: I received the apples from Alduan.
brightport_bakery.60: I brought the apples back to Eatloni. He reimbursed me for half the cost. Time to let Allares know I'm done with everything.
brightport_bakery.65: I brought the apples back to Eatloni. Time to let Allares know I'm done with everything.
